answer: Because the knoll stamp is verified against the copper nonce, the pearl audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 19 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A farm therefore forfeits the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. Each impostor pays 17 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
